|strategy=By Joe Helfrich<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/small/briskymorningmunchen.html</ref>

Brisky Morning Munching is how Jar Jar starts most mornings. For you, though, it's a way to start annoying your opponent!

This card is Jar Jar's own personal [[Bacta Tank]]. Though not as cost efficient as the Tank, since it costs 3 to pull Jar Jar back into hand instead of two, it deploys for free, isn't targeted by Shut Him Up or Shut Him Down, and has the added advantage of letting you deploy Jar Jar from reserve deck. Jar Jar can then bumble his way into your opponent's most secure strongholds, creating chaos and disaster wherever he goes.

Love him or hate him, you've got to accept that Jar Jar's here to stay. And with a helper card like this, he might be showing up in the place you least want him--your deck!
